name: Prettier on Save
description: Automatically formats files with Prettier after Claude writes or edits them, using the project's Prettier configuration
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Format with Prettier after file write/edit
FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"
if [[ -z "$FILE" ]]; then exit 0; fi
# Only format known file types
if [[ "$FILE" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx|css|scss|less|json|md|yaml|yml|html|vue|svelte)$ ]]; then
  if command -v npx &>/dev/null; then
    npx prettier --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null
    echo "Formatted with Prettier: $FILE"
  fi
fi
exit 0
